title: BUG: indexing error when setting item in empty Series which has a frequency

labels.name: Indexing
labels.description: Related to indexing on series/frames, not to indexes themselves

body:
Another somewhat degenerate case that works in 0.15.2, fails in 0.16.1

``` python
import pandas as pd

pd.show_versions()


ts = pd.TimeSeries()

ts[pd.datetime(2012, 1, 1)] = 47


ts2 = pd.TimeSeries(0, pd.date_range('2011-01-01', '2011-01-01'))[:0]

ts2[pd.datetime(2012, 1, 1)] = 47
```
